signals.content: A software factory for AI coding agents. Hand it a spec; it plans, builds, measures the result with checks the agent did not write, feeds the gap back, and stops only when independent checks agree. You stay on the loop, not in it.
signals.score_reason: high-value open-source ecosystem signal; agentic AI relevance. Final score: 72. Freshness: source age 0d.
signals.brief_en:
Title: 0xfauzi/kstrl

A software factory for AI coding agents. Users provide a specification; the system plans, builds, and evaluates the output using independent checks that the agent itself did not generate. Detected gaps are fed back for remediation, and the process iterates until external verification confirms compliance. Human operators remain in supervisory loop, not directly involved in code generation.

signals.title: GetActionSpace/mcp-context-server
signals.content: MCP Context Server — a FastMCP-based server providing persistent multimodal context storage for LLM agents.
signals.score_reason: high-value open-source ecosystem signal; agentic AI relevance; retrieval/RAG relevance; large language model relevance. Final score: 58. Freshness: source age 0d.
signals.brief_en:
Title: GetActionSpace/mcp-context-server

MCP Context Server is a FastMCP‑based service that offers persistent multimodal context storage for LLM agents. It enables agents to read, write, and retrieve structured context (text, images, embeddings) across sessions, supporting real‑time coordination and memory continuity. The server is designed for low latency, scalable deployment, and integrates via standard API endpoints. Current public information confirms its existence as an open‑source component, but performance metrics and adoption levels remain unverified.

العنوان: GetActionSpace/mcp-context-server
